A single shot under common lighting gives a more useful comparison, especially if colour coordination is central to the set. Look at texture and pattern spacing as well as apparent shade. A photograph can reveal a visible difference; it cannot fully establish how fabrics will look outdoors or after washing. Record what the picture actually shows, for example “both pieces in one frame, same visible stripe spacing,” instead of making a promise about identical fabric composition.
corrections.translation: Pencahayaan dan pengaturan kamera dapat membuat dua pakaian gelap tampak berbeda dalam foto terpisah. Minta keduanya difoto bersama di bawah cahaya yang sama, khususnya jika keserasian warna penting. Bandingkan tekstur, jarak antargaris, dan warna yang terlihat. Foto tidak membuktikan komposisi kain atau tampilan setelah dicuci dan di luar ruangan. Catat fakta seperti “kedua potong dalam satu foto, jarak garis tampak sama.”

corrections.source: Request the one missing piece of evidence
corrections.translation: Minta bukti yang masih diperlukan

corrections.source: OrientDig's detailed-photo guidance allows instructions about a particular angle, feature or measurement. Give the stored item's reference and state what you need to decide. If the overview shows both garments but no size labels, ask for a view identifying each label and the corresponding piece. If the seller promised a detachable belt, ask for both pieces and the belt laid out together. If the top has a distinctive embroidered cuff, request that cuff specifically. Choose a number of views consistent with the service you select.
corrections.translation: Layanan foto detail OrientDig memungkinkan permintaan sudut, ciri, atau pengukuran tertentu. Sertakan nomor barang gudang dan sebutkan keputusan yang ingin diambil. Jika foto umum sudah memperlihatkan kedua potong tetapi label ukuran tidak terbaca, minta foto label. Bila masalahnya model manset, minta foto manset tersebut. Sesuaikan jumlah sudut dengan layanan yang dipilih.

corrections.source: For example, a two-view request might ask for the whole set with the visible accessories, followed by an image of the shorts' waistband tape measurement. That gives one count check and one fit check. If you also need a readable top label, consider whether it can be shown clearly in the first frame or needs its own view. Avoid packing several incompatible requests into one close-up. A photograph wide enough to show an entire outfit will often make a small printed label unreadable on a phone.
corrections.translation: Misalnya, untuk dua foto mintalah satu gambar seluruh set beserta aksesori yang terlihat dan satu foto pita ukur pada pinggang celana. Yang pertama memeriksa jumlah, yang kedua ukuran. Jika label atasan juga penting, pertimbangkan apakah cukup terbaca dalam foto pertama atau perlu gambar sendiri. Permintaan yang terlalu padat sulit dipenuhi; foto seluruh set biasanya membuat teks label kecil sulit dibaca di ponsel.

corrections.source: Evaluate fit without mixing body and garment figures
corrections.translation: Bedakan ukuran tubuh dari ukuran pakaian saat menilai kecocokan

corrections.source: For the top, close buttons or zips if that matches the seller's measurement method. Ask for a straight flat width at named seams or a named length path. For the shorts, distinguish relaxed elastic width from a measurement under tension. A stretched elastic result depends on the force applied and can be difficult to reproduce. Measure your own garment with the same method. Compare the two observations rather than assuming an identical size label means identical dimensions across different sellers or styles.
corrections.translation: Untuk atasan, kancingkan atau tutup ritsleting bila demikian metode penjual. Tentukan jahitan awal dan akhir untuk lebar datar atau panjang. Untuk celana, bedakan lebar pinggang saat karet rileks dan ketika ditarik. Hasil saat ditarik bergantung pada gaya tarikan dan sulit diulang. Ukur pakaian Anda dengan cara yang sama lalu bandingkan. Label ukuran sama belum tentu berarti dimensi antarpenjual atau antarmodel sama.

corrections.source: Consider a hypothetical case in which your reference shorts measure 36 centimetres across the relaxed waistband and the warehouse photo seems to show 72 centimetres. Before deciding there is an enormous difference, verify whether one number refers to the full circumference. Also inspect where the tape begins and whether the garment is stretched. A chart may quote recommended body circumference instead of finished garment circumference. Name the measurement type when asking for clarification. Correcting a unit or endpoint misunderstanding can resolve a concern without changing the order.
corrections.translation: Misalnya, pinggang celana pembanding selebar 36 cm saat karet rileks, sedangkan foto gudang tampak menunjukkan 72 cm. Sebelum menyimpulkan ukurannya jauh berbeda, pastikan apakah angka kedua adalah lingkar penuh. Lihat titik nol pita ukur dan apakah karetnya ditarik. Tabel penjual juga mungkin menyebut lingkar tubuh yang disarankan, bukan lingkar pakaian jadi. Tanyakan jenis ukuran serta titik pengukurannya. Kesalahpahaman dapat diselesaikan tanpa mengubah pesanan.

corrections.source: Handle a partial mismatch as a set-level question
corrections.translation: Tangani kesalahan pada satu potong dengan mempertimbangkan seluruh set

corrections.source: Suppose the shirt is correct and the shorts are the wrong size. Record expected and observed sizes separately. Save the purchase option showing whether the set was sold together and ask the order channel what options apply. Do not assume the seller will exchange the shorts alone or require both pieces back; that depends on the actual terms and item. Keep packaging and tags while the issue is being assessed. If any service could alter return condition, such as removing labels or discarding a presentation box, hold that decision until you understand the consequences.
corrections.translation: Misalnya ukuran kemeja benar tetapi celananya salah. Catat ukuran pesanan dan ukuran yang diterima untuk masing-masing. Simpan varian pembelian yang menunjukkan apakah keduanya dijual sebagai satu set, lalu tanyakan penanganan yang tersedia lewat kanal pesanan. Jangan langsung menganggap satu potong bisa ditukar sendiri. Tunda pelepasan label atau pembuangan kotak hadiah sampai syaratnya jelas.

corrections.source: If a replacement is offered, clarify what will be sent and what must be returned. If only the bottom is replaced, the colour match may need another check when it arrives. Keep the original set reference and replacement reference distinct. Ask for evidence of the specific corrected feature before combining the pieces again. A second photograph showing the correct shorts size does not identify whether the replacement matches the fabric of the retained top, so revisit the questions that originally made the coordinated set worth buying.
corrections.translation: Jika penjual menawarkan penggantian, pastikan bagian apa yang akan dikirim dan apa yang perlu dikembalikan. Bila hanya celana diganti, periksa kesesuaian warnanya dengan atasan yang disimpan. Catat nomor set awal dan barang pengganti secara terpisah. Ukuran yang baru benar belum menjamin tekstur atau warna cocok. Periksa kembali detail yang membuat Anda memilih set tersebut sejak awal.

corrections.source: Check both pieces at packing and receipt
corrections.translation: Periksa kedua potong saat dikemas dan diterima

corrections.source: When the set is ready, look at how its warehouse records are represented in the parcel selection. Two components might appear together under one entry or separately. Match the selected entries with your completed unit list. If you intentionally send the top in one parcel and leave the bottom behind, document that choice. Otherwise, verify that both pieces are accounted for before dispatch. A parcel count of one can be correct for a complete set sold and stored together, but it cannot prove the physical count without context.
corrections.translation: Saat set siap dikirim, lihat cara gudang mencatat komponennya. Atasan dan bawahan mungkin berada di satu entri atau di dua entri terpisah. Cocokkan pilihan di formulir paket dengan daftar barang yang sudah diperiksa. Jangan hanya memilih sebuah entri karena gambarnya menampilkan pakaian lengkap. Sebaliknya, jangan meminta dua entri bila set lengkap memang dijual dan disimpan sebagai satu barang.

corrections.source: At delivery, keep the set together while comparing its contents with your saved overview and options. If a question arises, give both the original purchase reference and the outbound parcel reference. Explain which component is affected and what the earlier warehouse evidence showed. This gives support a meaningful timeline rather than a general complaint about an outfit. When everything matches, retain the measurements alongside the seller information for future sizing decisions. Your own verified comparison of this cut will be much more useful than a general claim that every set from a platform runs large or small.
corrections.translation: Di tujuan, biarkan kedua potong tetap bersama sambil mencocokkannya dengan foto gudang dan pilihan yang disimpan. Jika ada masalah, berikan nomor pembelian dan nomor paket internasional, sebutkan komponen terkait, dan jelaskan bukti sebelum pengiriman. Jika semuanya cocok, simpan ukuran aktual beserta informasi penjual sebagai pembanding untuk model yang sama. Hasil pemeriksaan ini lebih berguna daripada menyamaratakan ukuran seluruh set yang dijual di platform.

corrections.source: OrientDig shopping assistant guide
corrections.translation: Panduan layanan titip beli OrientDig

corrections.source: OrientDig detailed photo service
corrections.translation: Layanan foto detail barang OrientDig

corrections.source: A retail box may protect a product, complete a gift or preserve an unresolved return option. Decide what it does before comparing the cost of keeping or removing it.
corrections.translation: Kotak asli bisa melindungi produk, melengkapi hadiah, atau masih dibutuhkan untuk retur. Tentukan fungsinya sebelum membandingkan biaya mempertahankan dan membuangnya.

corrections.source: Identify the packaging layer you are talking about
corrections.translation: Tentukan lapisan kemasan yang dimaksud

corrections.source: An item can arrive inside a protective bag, a fitted insert, a retail box, a seller transport carton and another layer used for outbound international shipping. “Remove the box” is ambiguous when several boxes are involved. Ask which layer the warehouse means and describe it in plain language. For example, “the brown seller delivery carton outside the printed shoebox” identifies a different object from “the printed box holding the shoes.” Preserve photographs of the packaging arrangement when a distinction matters to your decision.
corrections.translation: Barang dapat melewati beberapa lapisan: kantong pelindung, dudukan sesuai bentuk barang, kotak asli produk, kardus kiriman penjual, lalu kardus pengiriman internasional. Perintah “buang kotaknya” tidak jelas jika ada lebih dari satu kotak. Tanyakan lapisan mana yang dimaksud gudang. Bila keputusan bergantung pada perbedaannya, simpan foto yang memperlihatkan susunan kemasan.

corrections.source: Begin with why you want a change. Perhaps the retail box is empty space around a soft accessory. Perhaps you want it intact because it is part of a present. Perhaps the corner of the box is damaged and you are deciding whether to return the item. Each reason suggests a different course. Do not authorize disposal before settling a return or exchange question. The seller's conditions and the handling already performed can affect the available options. Seek a specific answer for your actual order while the relevant materials still exist.
corrections.translation: Jelaskan alasan perubahan. Kemasan asli mungkin menyisakan ruang kosong di sekeliling aksesori lunak, diperlukan agar hadiah tetap lengkap, atau memiliki sudut penyok yang sedang Anda pertimbangkan untuk diretur. Dalam kasus terakhir, tanyakan dahulu apakah penjual mensyaratkan kemasan tetap utuh. Dapatkan jawaban yang berlaku untuk pesanan tersebut selagi semua bahan masih ada.

corrections.source: Separate protection, presentation and evidence
corrections.translation: Bedakan fungsi perlindungan, tampilan hadiah, dan bukti kondisi

corrections.source: A fitted insert can keep a fragile object away from the sides of a carton. A decorative sleeve may improve presentation while adding little structural protection. A printed label may identify the version or ingredients of an item even if the container itself is thin. Write a short note for each part: protects a projecting piece, holds small accessories together, identifies the purchased version, or matters to the recipient. This gives the warehouse a clearer description of what must be preserved than asking to retain “important packaging.”
corrections.translation: Dudukan yang pas dapat menjauhkan benda rapuh dari dinding kardus. Selubung dekoratif mungkin hanya memengaruhi tampilan. Label cetak dapat menunjukkan varian atau bahan walau wadah itu sendiri tidak diperlukan. Tentukan fungsi setiap bagian, misalnya penyangga, kemasan hadiah, atau bukti identitas barang. Beri tahu gudang tepatnya apa yang wajib disimpan, bukan sekadar meminta “kemasan penting”.

corrections.source: Think about who will receive the goods. A replacement item for personal use may be acceptable in plain protective packing. A gift set meant to be handed over as presented may be incomplete without the display carton. If a box is part of the product's value to you, include its condition in your warehouse review. Ask for photographs of the relevant surfaces and corners before the item enters an outbound parcel. A later image of a sealed shipping box will tell you little about a dented presentation carton inside it.
corrections.translation: Pertimbangkan penerimanya. Barang pengganti untuk dipakai sendiri mungkin cukup dikirim dengan pelindung polos. Set hadiah bisa dianggap tidak lengkap tanpa kotak pajangannya. Jika kotak itu bagian dari nilai produk, catat kondisinya dan mintalah foto sebelum masuk ke kardus pengiriman. Foto luar kardus tertutup tidak akan memperlihatkan penyok pada kotak hadiah di dalamnya.

corrections.source: Compare actual mass with the space the box uses
corrections.translation: Bandingkan berat aktual dengan ruang yang terpakai

corrections.source: A light box can matter to international freight because of its dimensions. OrientDig's billing-weight guidance describes estimating parcel packing and applying volumetric weight on applicable routes when it exceeds actual weight. Use the route's own terms for any calculation. Dimensions taken from a seller's retail box do not necessarily describe the outer international parcel; additional protection may increase them. Record which object you measured and whether the figures are observed, estimated or supplied after packing.
corrections.translation: Kotak ringan tetap dapat memengaruhi ongkir karena ukurannya. Panduan OrientDig menjelaskan perkiraan berat kemasan dan penggunaan berat volumetrik pada rute yang menerapkannya jika nilainya melebihi berat aktual. Gunakan aturan rute yang Anda pertimbangkan. Catat dimensi serta berat dan tandai mana yang diukur, diperkirakan, atau baru diperoleh setelah pengemasan.

corrections.source: As an illustration, compare a rectangular box measuring 32 by 22 by 13 centimetres with a flatter arrangement of 32 by 22 by 8. Their external volumes are 9,152 and 5,632 cubic centimetres respectively. That difference of 3,520 cubic centimetres is a change in physical volume. It is not a guaranteed monetary saving. The shipping carton may have different dimensions, another item may already determine its height or the selected route may bill on actual weight. Use the example to identify a question for the estimator, not a discount to subtract from your budget.
corrections.translation: Bandingkan contoh kotak 32 × 22 × 13 cm dengan susunan lebih pipih 32 × 22 × 8 cm. Volume luarnya masing-masing 9.152 dan 5.632 cm³, berbeda 3.520 cm³. Angka itu selisih volume, belum tentu penghematan uang. Kardus pengiriman dapat berbeda ukuran, barang lain mungkin sudah menentukan tingginya, atau rute menggunakan berat aktual. Gunakan selisih tadi sebagai dasar mengecek kalkulator ongkir.

corrections.source: Compare scenarios for the entire parcel
corrections.translation: Bandingkan pilihan kemasan untuk seluruh isi paket

corrections.source: Create a keep scenario and a remove scenario with the same contents, destination and relevant route assumptions. In each, identify the outer dimensions you expect and the protection the item would receive. If the shoe box would be placed beside another rigid carton of the same height, discarding it may leave the outer parcel's dimensions unchanged. If it is the longest or tallest piece, the effect could be greater. The packing arrangement matters as much as the volume of the individual box.
corrections.translation: Buat skenario kotak tetap disertakan dan skenario kotak dilepas dengan isi, tujuan, serta asumsi rute yang sama. Untuk masing-masing, catat perkiraan ukuran luar dan perlindungannya. Jika kotak sepatu berada di samping kotak kaku lain yang sama tinggi, membuangnya mungkin tidak mengubah ukuran paket. Jika kotak sepatu merupakan bagian paling panjang atau tinggi, dampaknya bisa lebih besar. Nilailah susunan seluruh isi.

corrections.source: If you request rehearsal packing, specify the actual list of items and which packaging layers must remain. OrientDig lists rehearsal packing as an optional way to get a packed parcel weight before submission. Check what figures are returned for your order. Changing the contents, discarding a box afterwards or asking for stronger outer protection can make the earlier result less applicable. Keep the record of which scenario was measured. A number without its contents and instructions is difficult to compare with the final parcel.
corrections.translation: Jika meminta simulasi pengemasan, sebutkan barang yang akan dimasukkan dan lapisan kemasan yang harus tetap ada. OrientDig mencantumkan layanan opsional ini untuk memperoleh berat paket sebelum pengiriman diajukan. Periksa data apa yang diberikan untuk pesanan Anda. Mengubah isi, membuang kotak setelah simulasi, atau menambah pelindung dapat mengubah hasil. Catat susunan yang diukur agar angkanya dapat dibandingkan dengan paket terakhir.

corrections.source: Avoid exchanging a known benefit for a speculative saving
corrections.translation: Pertimbangkan manfaat yang sudah pasti sebelum mengejar penghematan

corrections.source: A shoebox may protect the shape of the shoes or separate them from other contents. A jewellery box may keep small parts in one place. An electronics package may contain a fitted support tray that holds components apart. Removing these layers might be reasonable, but replacement protection should be considered. Describe which surfaces must remain separated and which small accessories need to travel together. Ask what packing options are actually offered rather than assuming that clothes elsewhere in the parcel will provide sufficient cushioning.
corrections.translation: Kotak sepatu dapat mempertahankan bentuk sepatu, kotak perhiasan menahan komponen kecil, dan kemasan elektronik mungkin memiliki baki yang memisahkan komponen. Jika lapisan itu dibuang, pertimbangkan perlindungan pengganti. Sebutkan permukaan yang perlu dipisahkan dan aksesori kecil yang harus tetap bersama. Tanyakan pilihan nyata yang ditawarkan gudang, tanpa menganggap pakaian lain di dalam kardus pasti menjadi bantalan yang cukup.

corrections.source: Evaluate the trade in concrete terms. Suppose preserving a box keeps a gift ready to present, while removing it might allow a smaller outer carton. If neither the final dimensions nor the route charge is known, the gift value is established and the freight saving is uncertain. You can investigate the uncertainty with a quote, choose to retain the box, or decide that the box has no value to the recipient. The right choice depends on the purchase. General statements such as “always remove shoe boxes” ignore the reason somebody bought that particular item.
corrections.translation: Misalnya, kotak yang dipertahankan membuat hadiah siap diberikan, sedangkan membuangnya mungkin memperkecil kardus pengiriman. Sebelum ukuran dan ongkir akhir diketahui, manfaat kotak sudah jelas sementara penghematannya masih perkiraan. Anda bisa meminta penawaran, mempertahankan kotak, atau memutuskan penerimanya tidak membutuhkan kotak tersebut. Anjuran umum untuk selalu membuang kotak sepatu mengabaikan alasan orang membeli barang itu.

corrections.source: Write instructions that a packer can distinguish
corrections.translation: Beri petunjuk yang membedakan setiap bagian kemasan

corrections.source: Use the warehouse item reference and name the packaging to keep and remove. One example: “For item [reference], keep the printed gift carton, fitted tray and accessory envelope together. The plain seller courier carton may be omitted if suitable outer protection is available. Please ask if this is unclear.” Adjust the instruction to the choices the service actually allows. A concise positive description of the pieces to retain is safer than a long list of materials that might all be called packaging.
corrections.translation: Sebutkan nomor barang gudang serta lapisan yang boleh dilepas dan yang wajib disimpan. Contohnya, “Untuk barang [nomor], pertahankan kotak hadiah bercetak, baki di dalamnya, dan amplop aksesori sebagai satu kesatuan. Kardus polos untuk kiriman dari penjual boleh dilepas bila kemasan penggantinya sesuai.” Periksa apakah susunan ini tersedia sebelum menyetujui pembuangan. Petunjuk yang spesifik mengurangi risiko salah membuang bagian.

corrections.source: If you need a visual record, distinguish item-level detailed photos from parcel photos. An item photo can document the condition of the printed box before packing. A pre-seal parcel view can help identify its placement relative to other goods. A sealed view can show exterior condition. OrientDig's published value-added services describe these different stages. Check the service description and order screen rather than assuming every photograph is included. Request the view that can still answer your question at that stage.
corrections.translation: Foto detail barang bisa mendokumentasikan kondisi kotak asli bercetak sebelum dikemas. Foto paket terbuka menunjukkan posisinya terhadap barang lain. Foto kardus tertutup hanya menunjukkan kondisi luar dan penandanya. Periksa layanan foto yang dipilih serta gambar apa saja yang termasuk. Minta sudut yang masih dapat menjawab pertanyaan pada tahap tersebut. Pilih layanan foto OrientDig yang sesuai dengan tahap pemeriksaan.

corrections.source: Record the decision and check the result at delivery
corrections.translation: Catat pilihan kemasan dan periksa hasilnya saat barang diterima

corrections.source: Before submission, save your chosen scenario, the reasons for keeping or removing each layer and any agreed service charge. Confirm the route accepts the actual contents. If your decision relied on keeping material intact for an exchange, verify that the exchange question has genuinely been resolved before authorizing an irreversible packing change. Once the parcel is sent, keep its reference with those instructions. If you need to ask about a discrepancy, cite the particular item and packaging layer rather than describing the whole shipment as incorrectly packed.
corrections.translation: Sebelum mengajukan kiriman, simpan pilihan kemasan, alasan menyimpan atau melepas tiap lapisan, dan biaya layanan yang disepakati. Pastikan rute menerima isi sebenarnya. Bila kemasan dipertahankan untuk keperluan penukaran, periksa apakah tujuan itu masih relevan sebelum barang dikirim. Jika instruksi tidak cocok dengan hasilnya, sebutkan lapisan tertentu yang berbeda.

corrections.source: At delivery, compare the packaging you received with the instruction and the visible condition documented earlier. If damage is present, retain the outer carton, internal protection and item packaging while you check the reporting procedure. If the trade worked well, save the actual dimensions and final charge for context when planning a similar parcel. That experience can improve your next estimate, but changes in contents, routes and pricing still deserve a fresh comparison. A good packaging decision can be explained in terms of the item it protected and the cost evidence available when you made it.
corrections.translation: Saat paket diterima, cocokkan kemasan dengan instruksi dan kondisi yang didokumentasikan sebelumnya. Jika ada kerusakan, simpan kardus luar, bantalan, dan kemasan barang selama memeriksa prosedur pelaporan. Jika barang tiba utuh, catat bagian kemasan yang benar-benar bermanfaat. Nilai pilihan semula berdasarkan barang yang dilindungi dan perkiraan biaya yang tersedia saat keputusan dibuat.

corrections.source: OrientDig packing and parcel-photo services
corrections.translation: Layanan pengemasan dan foto paket OrientDig

corrections.source: OrientDig actual and volumetric weight guidance
corrections.translation: Panduan berat aktual dan berat volumetrik OrientDig

corrections.source: A shorter box can matter more than a lighter one, or make no price difference at all. Compare two packing arrangements using the current route rules and the same actual contents.
corrections.translation: Kotak yang lebih pendek bisa lebih penting daripada kotak yang lebih ringan, atau justru tidak mengubah ongkir. Bandingkan dua susunan dengan isi yang sama berdasarkan aturan rute saat ini.

corrections.source: Name the two arrangements you are comparing
corrections.translation: Tentukan dua susunan kemasan yang ingin dibandingkan

corrections.source: Start with a concrete decision. Perhaps you want to keep the printed retail box around a pair of shoes but are willing to remove an oversized seller carton. Or you have a jacket that can be folded more compactly if doing so will not damage its shape. Give the proposed arrangements short descriptions tied to the actual physical changes. “Shoes in retail box beside folded jacket” and “shoes protected separately, jacket folded flat” say more than “large parcel” and “small parcel.”
corrections.translation: Bandingkan perubahan fisik yang nyata. Anda mungkin ingin menyimpan kotak sepatu bercetak tetapi tidak memerlukan kardus penjual yang terlalu besar, atau jaket dapat dilipat lebih pipih tanpa merusak bentuknya. Namai skenarionya dengan jelas, misalnya “sepatu dalam kotak asli di samping jaket terlipat” dan “sepatu dilindungi terpisah, jaket dilipat rata”. Ini lebih berguna daripada sekadar “paket besar” dan “paket kecil”.

corrections.source: Keep a list of the warehouse item references in both scenarios. The goods, quantity, destination and required protection should be the same unless the decision explicitly concerns changing them. If one scenario omits a second jacket altogether, it answers a different question: whether to send that jacket now or later. You can compare that too, but include the eventual second shipment in the cost analysis. An immediate low charge for a smaller package does not automatically mean the whole purchase will cost less to deliver.
corrections.translation: Catat nomor barang gudang untuk kedua skenario. Pertahankan isi, jumlah, tujuan, dan tingkat perlindungan yang sama kecuali perubahan itu memang sedang dibandingkan. Jika satu skenario menghilangkan jaket kedua, catat ongkir pengiriman sisanya. Ongkir satu paket yang lebih murah tidak otomatis berarti seluruh pembelian lebih murah dikirim.

corrections.source: Work in consistent units before using any formula
corrections.translation: Samakan satuan sebelum menggunakan rumus

corrections.source: Enter all external dimensions in the units the selected calculator expects. A box measuring 0.4 metres in length is 40 centimetres, and 400 millimetres is the same length again. A typo can move a route outside its size limits by a factor of ten. Confirm that the numbers describe the outer packed carton rather than the product itself or the internal space. Write the units next to every dimension and the actual mass. When sharing measurements with another person, a bare sequence such as “40, 30, 20, 3” is too easy to misread.
corrections.translation: Masukkan dimensi luar dengan satuan yang diminta kalkulator. Panjang 0,4 meter sama dengan 40 sentimeter atau 400 milimeter. Kesalahan satu angka bisa membuat ukuran tampak sepuluh kali lebih besar atau lebih kecil. Ukur kardus luar setelah dikemas, bukan barang atau ruang di dalamnya. Tuliskan satuan pada panjang, lebar, tinggi, dan berat. Deretan “40, 30, 20, 3” mudah disalahartikan jika dibagikan tanpa keterangan.

corrections.source: Multiply the three external dimensions to obtain the parcel volume, keeping the cubic unit. For example, a hypothetical 42 by 30 by 20 centimetre box occupies 25,200 cubic centimetres. Reducing its height to 16 centimetres gives 20,160 cubic centimetres, a reduction of 5,040 or one fifth of the original volume. This describes space, not money. The route's billing method and rounding determine whether the reduction changes the charge at all. The same difference in volume can matter differently across routes.
corrections.translation: Kalikan ketiga dimensi luar dengan satuan yang sama. Contoh kotak 42 × 30 × 20 cm memiliki volume 25.200 cm³. Jika tingginya dikurangi menjadi 16 cm, volumenya 20.160 cm³, turun 5.040 cm³ atau seperlima. Yang berkurang adalah ruang, belum tentu ongkir. Dampak pada harga bergantung pada dasar penagihan dan pembulatan masing-masing rute.

corrections.source: Understand which weight the route uses
corrections.translation: Periksa berat yang digunakan rute untuk menghitung ongkir

corrections.source: OrientDig's guide distinguishes estimated billing weight from packed results. It explains that stored goods have a recorded weight with their original packaging and that the system estimates packaging when preparing a parcel. On routes applying volume weight, a volumetric figure can govern when larger than actual weight. Read the current line's conditions for its divisor, unit requirements and other limits. A divisor seen in a forum example or a quote to a different destination cannot establish the terms of your own shipment.
corrections.translation: Panduan OrientDig membedakan perkiraan berat penagihan dari hasil setelah pengemasan. Berat barang yang tercatat di gudang bisa sudah mencakup kemasan asli; saat menyusun paket, sistem memperkirakan berat kemasan tambahan. Periksa aturan aktual dan volumetrik rute yang dipilih berdasarkan rincian saat ini. Contoh dari forum atau penawaran untuk negara tujuan lain tidak menentukan syarat kiriman Anda.

corrections.source: Use a calculation only when its assumptions are explicit. Suppose an illustrative route divided the example box's cubic centimetres by 6,000. The larger arrangement would yield 4.2 kilograms and the smaller 3.36 kilograms before any rounding. If the real parcel weighed 5 kilograms and the hypothetical rule charged the higher value, the physical mass would exceed both dimensional figures. In that example, a one-fifth reduction in volume would not reduce the comparison weight. With a much lighter parcel, the same dimensional change could matter. These figures illustrate the decision, not OrientDig tariffs.
corrections.translation: Misalnya, sebuah rute contoh membagi volume dalam cm³ dengan 6.000. Kedua kotak tadi menghasilkan berat volumetrik 4,2 kg dan 3,36 kg sebelum pembulatan. Jika berat aktual paket 5 kg dan rute menagih nilai yang lebih besar, berat aktual melampaui kedua angka tersebut. Mengecilkan volume seperlima tidak mengubah berat dasar perbandingan dalam kasus ini. Hasilnya dapat berbeda untuk paket yang jauh lebih ringan. Angka ini hanya contoh, bukan daftar tarif OrientDig.

corrections.source: Test the longest side separately from volume
corrections.translation: Periksa batas sisi terpanjang secara terpisah dari volume

corrections.source: Two boxes can have the same volume and very different shapes. A long narrow box can exceed a route's allowed side length even when its actual mass is low. Calculate or note the longest side in each arrangement. Check any combined-dimension requirements displayed by the route as well. Use the formula specified by the carrier if one appears; length plus girth and a simple sum of dimensions are different expressions. Do not interchange them because both happen to produce a number measured in centimetres.
corrections.translation: Dua kardus bisa memiliki volume sama tetapi bentuk berbeda. Paket panjang dan sempit dapat melewati batas sisi walau ringan. Catat sisi terpanjang serta aturan gabungan dimensi untuk setiap rute. Jika kurir menetapkan rumus, gunakan rumus itu. Panjang ditambah keliling penampang tidak sama dengan menjumlahkan panjang, lebar, dan tinggi meski keduanya dinyatakan dalam sentimeter.

corrections.source: Imagine comparing a 60 by 20 by 15 centimetre box with a 40 by 30 by 15 centimetre box. Each occupies 18,000 cubic centimetres. If a hypothetical route accepts a maximum side of 50 centimetres, the first shape would fail that single condition and the second would pass it. Passing one rule does not establish complete eligibility, because contents, weight, destination and other size limits may still apply. This is why the three individual sides belong in your saved comparison, not just the computed volume.
corrections.translation: Kotak 60 × 20 × 15 cm dan 40 × 30 × 15 cm masing-masing memiliki volume 18.000 cm³. Jika suatu rute contoh membatasi sisi terpanjang hingga 50 cm, kotak pertama tidak memenuhi batas itu, sedangkan kotak kedua memenuhi. Lolos satu aturan belum memastikan paket diterima; isi, berat, tujuan, atau batas ukuran lain tetap berlaku. Simpan ketiga dimensi, bukan volume saja.

corrections.source: Estimate only the variables you cannot yet measure
corrections.translation: Perkirakan hanya data yang belum dapat diukur

corrections.source: Early in the buying process, item weights may be seller descriptions or warehouse observations rather than final packed measurements. Keep them labelled. If a rigid item determines the minimum outer length, use that as a constraint on both scenarios. If a soft piece can fold, avoid assuming it can be compressed without affecting its condition. A range with a clear reason is better than an implausibly precise figure. You can update it when the warehouse supplies more information.
corrections.translation: Pada awal pembelian, berat mungkin berasal dari deskripsi penjual atau pengamatan gudang. Tandai sumbernya agar tidak dianggap berat paket jadi. Jika benda kaku menentukan panjang minimum kardus, gunakan sebagai batas bawah. Untuk bagian yang belum diukur, simpan kisaran wajar alih-alih angka yang tampak pasti. Perbarui perkiraan setelah gudang memberi ukuran lebih baik.

corrections.source: Decide whether uncertainty near a threshold is consequential. If both arrangements comfortably fit the route's visible limits and the quoted comparison barely changes, it may not be worth altering valued packaging. If one dimension is close to a listed maximum or a significant charge step, confirm the actual packed measurements before choosing. OrientDig lists rehearsal packing for buyers seeking a packed weight before submission. Ask what additional size information is provided or available for your parcel, and verify the service cost before using it for the comparison.
corrections.translation: Tentukan apakah selisih dekat batas rute dapat mengubah keputusan. Jika kedua susunan jauh di bawah batas dan perkiraan ongkir hampir sama, kemasan bernilai mungkin tidak perlu diubah. Jika salah satu dimensi mendekati batas, ukur dulu. Tanyakan data apa yang tersedia untuk paket Anda serta biaya layanan pengukuran atau simulasi, sebelum menggunakannya untuk membandingkan alternatif. OrientDig menawarkan pengemasan percobaan untuk mendapatkan berat paket sebelum pengajuan.

corrections.source: Recalculate after protection and optional services
corrections.translation: Hitung kembali setelah menambahkan pelindung dan layanan tambahan

corrections.source: External padding, reinforcement and a stronger outer carton may change several inputs at once. A thinner arrangement that requires extra protective spacing may end up nearer the original size than expected. A compact heavy package can cross an actual-weight threshold even when it fits a dimensional limit. Preserve the exact packing instruction used for each quote. A warehouse result for a protected parcel is more informative than a bare product measurement, but only for the goods and protection actually measured.
corrections.translation: Bantalan luar, penguat, dan kardus yang lebih kokoh dapat mengubah berat serta beberapa dimensi sekaligus. Susunan yang lebih tipis tetapi memerlukan ruang pelindung tambahan bisa berakhir hampir sama besar. Paket berat dan padat bisa tetap ditagih berdasarkan berat aktual. Setelah isi atau perlindungan berubah, hitung ulang. Hasil simulasi hanya berlaku untuk barang dan susunan yang benar-benar diukur.

corrections.source: For a valuable presentation carton, make its preservation an explicit requirement in both candidate arrangements. If the only way to fit a route is to discard it, the comparison becomes a choice between different deliverables. Record that in words rather than presenting the cheaper route as an unqualified improvement. Some buyers value the box; others do not. Your comparison should make the personal trade-off visible and leave the actual carrier rules to the current quote. Avoid authorizing irreversible disposal based solely on an early estimate.
corrections.translation: Jika kotak pajangan bernilai bagi Anda, masukkan syarat mempertahankannya dalam kedua skenario. Bila satu rute hanya bisa dipakai dengan membuang kotak, hasil yang diterima pembeli pun berubah. Jelaskan pertukaran antara biaya dan nilai kotak, lalu gunakan ketentuan rute dalam penawaran saat ini. Jangan menyetujui pembuangan yang tak bisa dibatalkan hanya berdasarkan perkiraan awal.

corrections.source: Save a record another person could reproduce
corrections.translation: Simpan catatan perhitungan yang bisa diperiksa ulang

corrections.source: For each scenario, keep its contents, destination, packing description, external dimensions, actual mass, billing basis, currency, quote time and route name. Mark figures that remain estimated. If two quotes differ substantially, isolate the change: did eligibility change, did billing weight change, did a different route become available, or did a service line change? Asking those questions in order makes it easier to spot input mistakes and avoids blaming a price increase on a dimension that never affected the applicable rule.
corrections.translation: Untuk setiap skenario, simpan daftar isi, tujuan, susunan kemasan, ukuran luar, berat aktual, dasar penagihan, mata uang, waktu penawaran, dan nama rute. Tandai angka perkiraan. Jika hasilnya jauh berbeda, periksa masukan serta aturan yang benar-benar menentukan harga. Dengan begitu Anda bisa mengenali kesalahan input dan tidak mengaitkan kenaikan ongkir dengan dimensi yang tidak memengaruhi tagihan.

corrections.source: When you finally choose, retain the result and its reason. “Kept the retail box because the actual mass determined the quote in both measured scenarios” is a reproducible decision. “Split the parcel because the measured longest side exceeded this route's current maximum” is another. At dispatch, check that the recorded outer measurements correspond to the final contents you actually send. Use the result as one reference for a future package, while remembering that a new destination, different item mix or updated carrier conditions can change the conclusion.
corrections.translation: Simpan keputusan beserta alasannya. Misalnya “kotak asli dipertahankan karena pada kedua susunan terukur ongkir ditentukan berat aktual” atau “paket dipisah karena sisi terpanjang melampaui batas rute”. Keputusan yang dicatat seperti itu bisa diperiksa kembali. Tujuan, kombinasi barang, atau ketentuan kurir yang berbeda dapat mengubah hasil.

corrections.source: A long box can also be easy to misread when a photo is rotated. Identify the longest physical edge before transcribing a photograph, then enter the remaining two edges with their units in the same record.
corrections.translation: Foto kotak panjang yang diputar bisa membingungkan. Tentukan sisi fisik terpanjang lebih dulu, lalu catat kedua sisi lainnya beserta satuan dalam entri yang sama.

corrections.source: OrientDig actual and volumetric weight
corrections.translation: Berat aktual dan berat volumetrik di OrientDig

corrections.source: OrientDig rehearsal packing service
corrections.translation: Layanan simulasi pengemasan OrientDig

corrections.source: The cheapest displayed line is useful only if it accepts the actual goods, dimensions and destination. Read restrictions in a deliberate order and keep a record of the case you checked.
corrections.translation: Rute termurah pada layar hanya berguna bila menerima barang, ukuran paket, dan alamat tujuan yang sebenarnya. Periksa pembatasan secara berurutan dan catat rincian kasus yang Anda bandingkan.

corrections.source: Describe the goods as they really are
corrections.translation: Jelaskan isi paket sesuai kondisi sebenarnya

corrections.source: Start route research with a contents list precise enough for somebody else to assess. “Accessories” might cover textile items, metal fittings, a battery-operated device or a container with liquid. These can raise different carrier questions. Record material, function, quantity and any feature the current service asks about. If you genuinely do not know whether an item contains a particular component, ask the seller or agent before proceeding. A vague category can make an estimate look attractive while leaving the actual eligibility question unanswered.
corrections.translation: Mulailah dengan daftar isi yang cukup rinci. “Aksesori” bisa berarti barang tekstil, komponen logam, perangkat berbaterai, atau wadah berisi cairan. Masing-masing dapat terkena aturan berbeda. Catat jenis barang, bahan, dan fitur yang diminta oleh rute. Kategori terlalu umum bisa menghasilkan perkiraan ongkir menarik tanpa menjawab apakah barang boleh dikirim.

corrections.source: Keep this record tied to the item or warehouse references. If one parcel contains several different goods, a rule affecting one piece can affect the whole combination. Do not relabel a restricted item as an ordinary garment or omit it to obtain a quote. Ask which service can accept the correctly described contents or whether the shipment needs a different arrangement. The point of reading exclusions early is to avoid paying or packing around a route that cannot handle what you plan to send.
corrections.translation: Kaitkan daftar tersebut dengan nomor barang gudang. Satu barang yang tidak memenuhi aturan dapat memengaruhi seluruh paket. Jangan mengganti nama atau menyembunyikan sifat barang agar tampak memenuhi syarat. Tanyakan pilihan yang benar-benar tersedia berdasarkan isinya. Tujuan memeriksa pengecualian sejak awal adalah menghindari biaya dan pengemasan untuk rute yang tidak dapat digunakan.

corrections.source: Separate four kinds of restriction
corrections.translation: Bedakan empat jenis pembatasan

corrections.source: One restriction concerns what a platform or service will handle. Another concerns the selected route's contents or packing conditions. Physical limits concern weight and dimensions, and geographic limits concern destination and delivery area. These categories can overlap, but checking one does not resolve them all. A small parcel that fits the weight limit might still contain an ineligible item. An item eligible in principle may have no available service to your particular address. A general logistics introduction cannot override a condition displayed on the actual route.
corrections.translation: Pisahkan aturan platform, ketentuan isi atau pengemasan rute, batas fisik seperti berat dan ukuran, serta jangkauan geografis. Barang yang ditangani platform belum tentu diterima rute tertentu. Ukuran yang memenuhi syarat juga belum menjamin alamat tujuan Anda dilayani. Ketentuan pada pilihan rute sebenarnya lebih spesifik daripada pengenalan umum tentang layanan logistik.

corrections.source: When reading a restriction, identify the object it describes. Is the limit per item, per parcel, per side, per shipment value or per destination? If a condition says that a feature requires specific packing, ask whether that packing is available for your order. If a term is unclear, keep the exact wording and route name in your notes and request clarification for the real contents. Avoid turning one buyer's successful shipment into evidence that the written restriction will be ignored for yours.
corrections.translation: Tentukan satuan setiap pembatasan: per barang, per paket, per sisi, berdasarkan nilai kiriman, atau per tujuan. Jika suatu fitur membutuhkan kemasan tertentu, periksa apakah kemasan itu tersedia. Simpan bunyi aturan dan ajukan pertanyaan spesifik bila masih meragukan. Keberhasilan kiriman orang lain tidak membuktikan pembatasan tertulis akan diabaikan untuk paket Anda.

corrections.source: Compare the dimensions against the exact rule
corrections.translation: Cocokkan ukuran dengan aturan rute yang tepat

corrections.source: Use the finished outer box where possible. Write down length, width, height and actual mass with their units. Check which side is longest. Read whether the route states a maximum single side, a sum of dimensions or another formula. A sum of three sides and a length-plus-girth formula are not interchangeable. If final packing is unknown, mark your measurements as estimates and leave a margin for protection. A retail box measured at a maximum length before adding an outer carton deserves particular caution.
corrections.translation: Gunakan ukuran kardus luar setelah pengemasan jika tersedia. Catat panjang, lebar, tinggi, berat aktual, dan satuannya. Temukan sisi terpanjang. Baca apakah rute membatasi satu sisi, jumlah dimensi, atau ukuran gabungan dengan rumus khusus. Jika kotak asli sendiri sudah mendekati batas, sisakan ruang untuk kardus pengiriman dan pelindung.

corrections.source: For a hypothetical illustration, suppose an item sits in a rigid 48-centimetre retail box and a candidate route lists a 50-centimetre maximum side. Entering 48 gives only two centimetres for outer packaging and protective space across both ends. That may or may not be feasible. Rather than assuming the carton will fit, ask for the outer packed dimension or compare a clearly identified alternative. If discarding the retail box is the only apparent solution, decide whether it is required for protection or presentation before authorizing any change.
corrections.translation: Misalnya, barang berada dalam kotak kaku sepanjang 48 cm dan suatu rute menetapkan batas sisi 50 cm. Tersisa hanya 2 cm untuk kemasan luar dan pelindung di kedua ujung jika memakai kotak itu. Belum tentu cukup. Mintalah ukuran paket jadi atau bandingkan susunan alternatif yang jelas. Bila solusinya mengharuskan membuang kotak asli, tentukan lebih dulu apakah kotak itu penting untuk perlindungan atau tampilan hadiah.

corrections.source: Read billing conditions independently of acceptance
corrections.translation: Bedakan syarat penerimaan barang dari dasar perhitungan ongkir

corrections.source: OrientDig's weight guide describes actual and volumetric considerations for applicable lines. A parcel can be physically accepted and still be billed on a weight different from its scale reading. Conversely, a calculated dimensional figure below a headline weight limit does not prove the parcel meets every separate size rule. In your comparison, give eligibility and pricing their own columns. Establish acceptance first. Then estimate the amount using the billing basis, unit rules and current charges of the eligible route.
corrections.translation: Panduan OrientDig menjelaskan berat aktual dan volumetrik untuk rute yang menerapkannya. Paket yang diterima secara fisik masih dapat ditagih berdasarkan angka yang berbeda dari hasil timbangan. Sebaliknya, perkiraan harga tidak membuktikan paket memenuhi syarat. Periksa kelayakannya dahulu, lalu hitung ongkir dengan dasar penagihan, satuan, dan biaya terkini dari rute tersebut.

corrections.source: Suppose you have a lightweight but bulky soft item. A route with an attractive rate per kilogram may use volume when it exceeds actual mass. A different line may impose a longest-side condition. Folding the item could make the physical dimensions smaller, but extra protection may partly offset the change. Build two complete scenarios with honest dimensions instead of mixing the lowest weight from one with the smallest box from another. A quote based on a combination you cannot actually ship has little value as a decision tool.
corrections.translation: Barang lunak yang ringan tetapi besar mungkin ditagih berdasarkan volume meski tarif per kilogram tampak murah. Rute lain bisa membatasi sisi terpanjang. Melipat barang mungkin memperbaiki satu aspek, tetapi jangan menganggapnya memenuhi aturan lain atau aman untuk bentuk barang. Bandingkan paket yang benar-benar dapat Anda kirim.

corrections.source: Check destination and delivery service requirements
corrections.translation: Periksa tujuan dan persyaratan layanan pengantaran

corrections.source: Use the intended destination and address details that the estimator or route asks for. A route offered to one country, region or type of delivery point may be conditional for another. Check any destination restrictions or special handling notes shown with the result. If delivery timing matters, record whether the displayed interval is described as estimated and when it begins. OrientDig's logistics overview describes multiple stages after warehouse packing, including carrier collection and local delivery. A single date on a shopping plan cannot bypass those stages.
corrections.translation: Masukkan tujuan dan jenis alamat yang diminta kalkulator atau rute. Layanan untuk suatu negara, wilayah, atau titik pengantaran bisa berbeda di tempat lain. Periksa syarat tujuan dan catatan waktu yang ditampilkan. Pengiriman masih mencakup pengemasan di gudang, penjemputan oleh pengangkut, dan pengantaran setempat. Tanggal yang Anda inginkan tidak meniadakan tahap tersebut. Periksa dukungan tujuan dan layanan yang tercantum pada rute OrientDig.

corrections.source: If the route description discusses recipient actions or supporting information, determine what is expected before submitting. For legal or customs questions specific to a destination, use the responsible official authority and current platform or carrier guidance for the actual shipment. An independent spreadsheet cannot determine an individual's legal requirements or guarantee clearance. Keep any relevant communication with the shipment record so that a request received later can be related to the parcel you actually sent.
corrections.translation: Jika penerima perlu melakukan sesuatu atau memberikan informasi, cari tahu kewajibannya sebelum mengirim. Untuk persoalan hukum atau bea cukai yang khusus berlaku di tujuan, gunakan sumber otoritas yang berwenang. Simpan informasi terkait bersama catatan kiriman agar permintaan berikutnya dapat dicocokkan dengan paket yang sebenarnya.

corrections.source: Check protection and exclusions before interpreting a price difference
corrections.translation: Periksa perlindungan dan pengecualian sebelum membandingkan harga

corrections.source: A service may accept an object while limiting the circumstances under which loss or damage can be claimed. Acceptance is not the same as comprehensive cover. Read the route's applicable service terms, packing requirements, reporting process and any exclusions relevant to the contents. If an optional protection service appears, identify what is added and what conditions remain. A price difference can reflect different included services, but a higher price alone does not establish more extensive protection.
corrections.translation: Layanan bisa menerima barang tetapi membatasi klaim kehilangan atau kerusakan pada keadaan tertentu. Periksa syarat rute, pengecualian, bukti yang dibutuhkan, serta layanan tambahan yang benar-benar dipilih. Selisih harga dapat mencerminkan layanan yang berbeda, tetapi harga lebih mahal saja tidak membuktikan cakupan perlindungan lebih luas.

corrections.source: For a fragile decorative item, ask about the material and how it will be packed instead of asking only whether the line is “safe.” If the rule is ambiguous, a written question naming the item, proposed packing and route can produce an answer you can use. Save that answer and date it. Avoid restating the answer as a general policy for other products or destinations. Conditions can depend on the particular case and may change. The relevant record is the one connected to your actual parcel selection.
corrections.translation: Untuk hiasan mudah pecah, sebutkan bahan dan rencana pengemasannya. Menanyakan apakah rute “aman” saja terlalu umum untuk mendapat jawaban yang dapat digunakan. Jika syaratnya kurang jelas, ajukan pertanyaan tertulis yang menyebut barang, kemasan yang diusulkan, dan kerusakan yang ingin dikonfirmasi. Simpan jawaban dengan pilihan rute aktual sebab ketentuan dan kasus dapat berbeda.

corrections.source: Choose a route only after resolving decisive uncertainties
corrections.translation: Pilih rute setelah syarat penentu dipastikan

corrections.source: Create a short decision list for each line. Mark each relevant condition as satisfied, unresolved or failed. A failed condition removes that route for the current parcel. An unresolved one tells you exactly what to ask or measure. If a different packing arrangement or split shipment could make a route available, treat that as a new scenario with its own costs and implications for the remaining items. Retain the original so you can see why the change was proposed.
corrections.translation: Buat daftar syarat untuk setiap rute. Tandai mana yang terpenuhi, belum jelas, atau gagal. Satu syarat yang gagal berarti rute tersebut belum cocok untuk susunan saat ini; syarat yang belum jelas menunjukkan apa yang harus ditanyakan atau diukur. Jika memakai kemasan lain atau memisahkan pengiriman dapat membuka rute, buat skenario baru beserta ongkir dan dampaknya pada barang lain. Simpan pula catatan awal sebagai pembanding.

corrections.source: Before payment, check that the selected route, contents and final packed dimensions match the conditions you assessed. If an excluded piece was removed, verify it remains correctly recorded in storage and review its own options. If packaging changed, revisit the physical limits. Save the final route name, quote and reason for selection with the outbound reference. Later, if the service changes or a shipment query arises, you will be able to explain which restrictions you checked, what evidence you used and what the platform confirmed for your particular parcel.
corrections.translation: Sebelum membayar, pastikan rute, isi, dan ukuran akhir sesuai dengan yang dinilai. Jika barang yang tidak diterima rute dikeluarkan dari paket, pastikan catatan gudangnya masih benar. Simpan syarat serta bukti yang Anda gunakan dan konfirmasi platform untuk paket tersebut. Jika ada perubahan, tinjau kembali pilihan berdasarkan kondisi terbaru.

corrections.source: If you are ordering a bundle, check its smallest accessories separately. A listing for a lamp may also show a battery or a power adapter. Ask the seller what actually ships in the selected option, then give that description to the agent before comparing available routes again.
corrections.translation: Periksa juga aksesori terkecil dalam paket bundel. Foto lampu bisa menampilkan baterai atau adaptor daya yang belum tentu disertakan. Tanyakan pada penjual apa yang benar-benar dikirim untuk varian tersebut, kemudian berikan keterangan itu kepada agen sebelum membandingkan rute lagi.

corrections.source: OrientDig help and shipping guidance
corrections.translation: Pusat bantuan dan panduan pengiriman OrientDig

corrections.source: OrientDig logistics platform introduction
corrections.translation: Pengenalan layanan logistik OrientDig

corrections.source: International tracking can switch providers and use more than one reference. Read the event, location and carrier together to find the last confirmed movement and the right next question.
corrections.translation: Pelacakan internasional dapat berpindah penyedia dan menggunakan lebih dari satu nomor. Baca kejadian, lokasi, dan nama kurir bersama-sama untuk mengetahui pergerakan terakhir yang terkonfirmasi serta apa yang masih perlu ditanyakan.

corrections.source: Identify the outbound shipment before interpreting a scan
corrections.translation: Kenali kiriman internasional sebelum menafsirkan hasil pemindaian

corrections.source: Open the OrientDig parcel record associated with the goods you actually submitted for international shipment. Record its reference, selected route and the tracking number shown for that journey. Keep domestic seller tracking elsewhere. A domestic number can show a delivery to the warehouse in China long before your international parcel is packed. Seeing “delivered” against the seller number is therefore not evidence of delivery at your home. First establish which journey, provider and destination each number describes.
corrections.translation: Buka catatan OrientDig untuk barang yang sudah Anda ajukan dalam kiriman internasional. Simpan nomor paket, rute, dan resinya. Pisahkan dari nomor paket domestik yang dikirim penjual ke gudang. Status “diterima” pada resi domestik belum berarti paket internasional tiba di alamat Anda.

corrections.source: Imagine that you bought a backpack and several accessories from two sellers. Their domestic parcels reached the warehouse on separate dates, but you selected the goods for one international package. Your purchase history may now contain two domestic tracking numbers, several warehouse references and one outbound parcel record. If the local delivery company later assigns a replacement number, that is another tracking identity for the outbound journey, not a new shopping order. Make a small map linking the numbers before contacting anyone about a missing update.
corrections.translation: Misalnya, ransel dan beberapa aksesori dari dua penjual tiba di gudang pada hari berbeda, lalu digabung menjadi satu paket internasional. Riwayatnya bisa memiliki dua resi domestik, beberapa nomor barang gudang, serta satu nomor paket internasional. Jika kurir tujuan menerbitkan nomor baru, itu nomor lain untuk perjalanan paket yang sama. Catat hubungan antarresinya sebelum menanyakan pembaruan yang belum terlihat.

corrections.source: Put the displayed event into the delivery sequence
corrections.translation: Tempatkan status terbaru dalam urutan perjalanan paket

corrections.source: OrientDig's logistics overview describes warehouse packing, collection by a logistics provider, security processing, flight arrangement, possible transit, destination processing, clearance and local delivery. Use that broad sequence as context rather than a promise that every event will appear as a public scan. A shipment may pass through a stage without displaying the exact wording you expect. A service label or account status can also be created before the carrier records physical acceptance of the parcel.
corrections.translation: OrientDig menjelaskan tahapan pengemasan, penjemputan oleh penyedia logistik, pemeriksaan keamanan, pengaturan penerbangan, kemungkinan transit, pemrosesan di tujuan, pengurusan kepabeanan, dan pengantaran lokal. Gunakan urutan umum ini sebagai konteks. Tidak setiap tahap harus muncul sebagai pemindaian publik. Bedakan tahap yang mungkin sedang dilalui dari kejadian yang benar-benar dicatat pengangkut.

corrections.source: Write the latest confirmed event in plain language. “Carrier received electronic information” usually conveys less than a physical acceptance scan, but read the carrier's actual wording rather than relying on a guessed code translation. “Arrived at sorting facility” describes a facility event and may not establish departure toward the next country. Include the timestamp and location exactly as shown, plus the source of the event. A combined tracking service may summarize several carriers, whereas a provider's own record can clarify which company generated a particular update.
corrections.translation: Jelaskan status terbaru dengan kata-kata sederhana. “Kurir menerima informasi elektronik” umumnya belum menunjukkan serah terima fisik. Bacalah keterangan asli kurir sebelum menebak arti suatu kode. “Tiba di fasilitas sortir” menunjukkan kejadian di fasilitas itu, belum tentu berarti paket sudah berangkat ke tujuan berikut. Gunakan waktu dan lokasi yang tercantum agar tidak menyimpulkan lebih dari yang diketahui.

corrections.source: Understand the transition to a delivery partner
corrections.translation: Pahami perpindahan paket ke mitra pengantaran

corrections.source: An international logistics provider may carry the shipment for one portion and use a destination delivery partner for the final portion. A handoff can involve a different tracking number or the same number recognized by another service. Look for a named local carrier, alternate reference or explicit handoff information in the parcel or carrier record. Where one is supplied, save it beside the original number. If none is supplied, avoid guessing a provider from the format of the digits alone.
corrections.translation: Penyedia internasional bisa menangani satu bagian perjalanan, lalu menyerahkan bagian akhir kepada mitra di negara tujuan. Kurir lokal mungkin memakai resi baru atau mengenali resi lama. Cari nama kurir, nomor alternatif, atau catatan serah terima yang jelas pada halaman paket atau situs pengangkut. Simpan bersama resi awal. Jika belum tersedia, jangan menebak nama kurir hanya dari pola angkanya.

corrections.source: A common point of confusion is an alternate number that exists before the local carrier records receiving the parcel. The existence of a local label can identify a planned delivery relationship without proving physical handover. Look for the strongest subsequent observation available, such as a scan recorded by the local provider. If the international record says handed over but the local record shows only electronic information, preserve both statements with their times. This is a useful specific discrepancy to ask about if the expected interval passes.
corrections.translation: Resi lokal bisa dibuat sebelum kurir setempat menerima paket secara fisik. Adanya label menunjukkan rencana pengantaran, belum membuktikan serah terima. Cari bukti berikutnya seperti pemindaian penerimaan oleh kurir lokal. Jika kedua sistem menunjukkan tahap berbeda, simpan kedua catatan dan tanyakan tentang perpindahan yang belum terkonfirmasi.

corrections.source: Compare times, not just the order of lines on screen
corrections.translation: Bandingkan waktu kejadian, bukan sekadar urutan baris di layar

corrections.source: Tracking feeds can use local times, different time zones or translated summaries. Check whether a displayed time includes a zone or identifies the facility location. An event posted later on your screen may describe an earlier physical movement. A flight-related status in one country and a facility update in another may appear out of sequence if you compare clock times without their zones. If the time basis is unavailable, mark it unknown and avoid precise claims about how many hours the parcel spent between events.
corrections.translation: Lini masa pelacakan dapat memakai waktu lokal, zona waktu berbeda, atau ringkasan terjemahan. Periksa zona waktu dan lokasi fasilitas jika tercantum. Informasi yang baru tampil bisa merujuk pada pergerakan fisik sebelumnya. Status penerbangan dan status fasilitas di negara lain dapat terlihat tidak berurutan. Simpan waktu beserta sumbernya sebelum menarik kesimpulan.

corrections.source: Keep an event log short and meaningful. For each change that affects your next action, write the date, event, provider and what it actually establishes. You rarely need to copy every repeated transit message. A useful sequence might identify physical acceptance, the last international facility, a named handoff and the first destination-carrier scan. That evidence allows you to ask about a specific gap rather than simply stating that tracking is slow. Avoid sharing a full address or label publicly when discussing a route with other buyers.
corrections.translation: Catat perubahan yang memengaruhi langkah Anda: tanggal, kejadian, penyedia, dan hal yang benar-benar terkonfirmasi. Tidak perlu menyalin setiap pesan transit berulang. Rangkaian singkat bisa berisi penerimaan fisik, fasilitas internasional terakhir, serah terima yang dilaporkan, dan pemindaian pertama oleh kurir tujuan. Dengan ini Anda dapat menanyakan satu celah tertentu. Jangan memublikasikan alamat lengkap atau label pengiriman saat berdiskusi dengan pembeli lain.

corrections.source: Distinguish an estimated interval from a service guarantee
corrections.translation: Bedakan perkiraan waktu tiba dari jaminan layanan

corrections.source: OrientDig notes that the delivery estimate shown after dispatch is indicative and that events such as weather, processing or provider delays can affect progress. Use the estimate displayed for your selected service and the date from which it is measured. It does not necessarily start on the day you paid for the merchandise. Seller fulfillment and domestic delivery precede the international shipment. Count the relevant interval from the appropriate parcel event and check whether the estimate uses business days or calendar days if specified.
corrections.translation: Menurut OrientDig, perkiraan waktu yang tampil setelah pengiriman bersifat indikatif. Cuaca, pemrosesan, atau keterlambatan penyedia dapat memengaruhi perjalanan paket. Gunakan perkiraan rute pilihan dan periksa perhitungan dimulai dari kejadian apa. Perhitungan belum tentu dimulai saat Anda membayar barang; pemenuhan oleh penjual dan pengiriman domestik terjadi sebelum perjalanan internasional. Jika disebutkan, bedakan hari kerja dari hari kalender.

corrections.source: An unchanged scan within the displayed estimate can be inconvenient without proving a parcel is lost. Equally, an actionable request for address clarification or collection should not be ignored merely because the estimated end date has not arrived. Read the latest event for an action, deadline or named contact channel. Use the platform and carrier's independently verified services to check the request. Do not send personal information or payment to a contact merely because an unsolicited message repeats a familiar-looking tracking number.
corrections.translation: Status yang belum berubah selama rentang perkiraan belum membuktikan paket hilang. Sebaliknya, pemberitahuan yang meminta tindakan bisa perlu ditanggapi sebelum perkiraan tanggal tiba. Baca apakah ada langkah, tenggat, atau saluran kontak yang disebutkan. Gunakan informasi kurir terkait dan catatan paket untuk memutuskan apakah perlu bertanya atau menunggu pembaruan terkonfirmasi.

corrections.source: Prepare a useful tracking inquiry
corrections.translation: Siapkan pertanyaan pelacakan yang mudah ditindaklanjuti

corrections.source: If the status needs clarification, provide the outbound parcel reference, route, original number, verified alternate number and last confirmed event with time and location. State what you expected to see next and which records you checked. “The international provider reports handoff on [date], but the named local provider shows only label information under [reference]” is concise and specific. It gives the platform a concrete relationship to investigate. A screenshot of your entire cart mostly adds unrelated product information.
corrections.translation: Jika status belum jelas, sertakan nomor paket internasional, rute, resi awal dan alternatif yang sudah diverifikasi, kejadian terakhir, waktu, serta lokasi. Jelaskan apa yang diharapkan selanjutnya dan catatan yang telah diperiksa. Misalnya, “Kurir internasional melaporkan serah terima pada [tanggal], sedangkan kurir lokal baru menunjukkan data label untuk [resi].” Rincian itu lebih mudah ditelusuri daripada tangkapan layar seluruh keranjang belanja.

corrections.source: Where the event says a delivery attempt was made, check the local provider's actual notice before requesting redelivery or collection. Identify the address or pickup instructions privately through the relevant official channel. If the record says delivered but you cannot locate the parcel, check the stated delivery details and any authorized receiving location, then follow the current reporting procedure promptly. Preserve the parcel reference and visible evidence. Do not infer the exact recipient or delivery location solely from a generic “delivered” label.
corrections.translation: Bila status menunjukkan upaya pengantaran, periksa pemberitahuan asli kurir lokal sebelum meminta kirim ulang atau mengambil paket. Konfirmasikan alamat atau petunjuk pengambilan melalui kanal resmi secara pribadi. Jika status sudah diterima tetapi paket belum ditemukan, cek rincian penyerahan dan tanyakan melalui saluran yang sesuai dengan menyertakan nomor paket.

corrections.source: Close the handoff record at receipt
corrections.translation: Lengkapi catatan serah terima setelah paket diterima

corrections.source: Once the parcel arrives, match the label or verified local reference to the outbound record. This matters if several packages were travelling at the same time. Compare contents with the selected parcel, not with every purchase on your account. If an item is absent, first establish whether it was supposed to be in this particular shipment. Tracking can support the movement of a parcel; it does not by itself establish what the warehouse packed inside it or the condition of each piece.
corrections.translation: Sesudah paket tiba, cocokkan label atau resi lokal terverifikasi dengan catatan kiriman internasional. Ini penting jika beberapa paket sedang berjalan. Bandingkan isi dengan barang yang dipilih untuk paket itu, bukan dengan semua pembelian di akun. Jika ada yang belum ditemukan, pastikan terlebih dahulu apakah barang tersebut memang seharusnya ikut dalam kiriman itu.

corrections.source: Keep the final local number linked to the original until any delivery issue is resolved. If everything arrives as expected, preserve the useful route information for your own future planning, including the time at which the local reference became recognizable. Treat that as an observation from one shipment. It can tell you what records were useful to follow, but it cannot guarantee that a future carrier will use the same partner, publish the same scans or take the same time. The dependable habit is linking the references and reading each event according to the provider that actually recorded it.
corrections.translation: Pertahankan hubungan resi lokal terakhir dengan resi internasional hingga masalah selesai. Jika barang tiba sesuai harapan, simpan informasi yang berguna, termasuk kapan resi lokal mulai dikenali. Pengalaman satu kiriman dapat menjadi petunjuk untuk pengiriman berikutnya, tetapi bukan jaminan waktu atau pola pelacakan yang sama. Cocokkan setiap kejadian dengan penyedia yang benar-benar mencatatnya.

corrections.source: When sharing the timeline with a recipient, include the latest confirmed location and the name of the carrier that supplied it. A guess based on the next planned stop may send someone to a local collection point before the parcel has arrived.
corrections.translation: Saat membagikan perkembangan kepada penerima, sebutkan lokasi terakhir yang sudah terkonfirmasi dan kurir yang melaporkannya. Menebak berdasarkan tujuan berikutnya bisa membuat orang datang ke tempat pengambilan sebelum paket tiba.

corrections.source: OrientDig official help
corrections.translation: Pusat bantuan resmi OrientDig

corrections.source: A usable request lets the purchasing team identify one live offer and one acceptable selection. Prepare the seller link, original option text, unit count and substitution instructions before submitting it.
corrections.translation: Permintaan yang jelas membantu tim pembelian menemukan satu penawaran yang masih aktif dan satu pilihan yang Anda setujui. Siapkan tautan penjual, nama varian asli, jumlah satuan, dan petunjuk jika stok habis sebelum mengajukan pembelian.

corrections.source: Decide what information the assistant needs to place this purchase
corrections.translation: Tentukan informasi yang diperlukan untuk membeli barang ini

corrections.source: A shopping assistant cannot reliably infer your preferred version from a picture of a model wearing several pieces. Start with one sentence describing what you intend to buy. It should identify the object, version, size or dimensions, colour and quantity. If an accessory matters, state whether it is included in the selected offer or something you need confirmed. “One navy cropped overshirt in size large, with the detachable collar shown for option B” gives a purchasing assistant a much clearer target than “buy this outfit.”
corrections.translation: Asisten belanja sulit menebak pilihan Anda hanya dari foto model mengenakan beberapa potong pakaian. Sebutkan barang, versi, ukuran, warna, dan jumlah dalam satu kalimat. Bila aksesori penting, jelaskan apakah sudah termasuk atau masih perlu dikonfirmasi. Misalnya, “Satu kemeja luaran pendek warna biru tua ukuran L, dengan kerah lepas-pasang seperti pada pilihan B.” Permintaan ini jauh lebih jelas daripada “beli setelan ini”.

corrections.source: OrientDig's shopping-assistant guide describes pasting an original seller link or searching for an item and choosing from available results. Use those routes to identify the exact offer first. The stable item identifier and seller information are useful when a short link or translated result is ambiguous. A product page and a shop home page are different kinds of source. If your saved link opens a shop or app promotional screen, recover the individual product page before treating the request as ready for purchase.
corrections.translation: Panduan OrientDig menjelaskan pencarian dari tautan produk asli atau hasil pencarian. Gunakan cara itu untuk membuka tawaran tertentu, bukan sekadar halaman toko, album, atau gambar promosi. Jika tautannya belum mengarah ke halaman produk yang dapat dipesan, temukan halaman tersebut terlebih dahulu.

corrections.source: Capture the original option wording
corrections.translation: Simpan nama varian sebagaimana tertulis di halaman penjual

corrections.source: Open the live offer and select the version you want. Copy or save the exact option wording alongside any translation. A translation that converts two labels to “dark blue” may hide suffixes distinguishing thickness, cut, season or bundle contents. A single letter, number or short phrase can change what the seller will ship. Record the option code exactly as shown and attach a clear selection screenshot if the available order flow permits. Point out which part of the original wording distinguishes your choice.
corrections.translation: Pilih varian pada halaman penjual dan simpan persis kata-kata aslinya di samping terjemahan. Dua pilihan yang sama-sama diterjemahkan sebagai “biru tua” mungkin berbeda ketebalan, potongan, musim, atau isi paket. Satu huruf atau angka bisa mengubah barang yang dikirim. Catat kode varian sebagaimana tertulis dan, jika tersedia, lampirkan tangkapan layar pilihan aktif. Tunjukkan akhiran atau kata yang membedakan pilihan Anda.

corrections.source: Try reopening the link in a separate tab. If it restores the same listing but resets the selected options, the link identifies the product rather than the complete purchase. Keep the option text in the request even when the thumbnail looks right. If the seller's listing has changed since you saved it, use the current live wording and decide whether it still meets your requirements. An old screenshot can explain what you originally wanted. It cannot make an unavailable option orderable or establish a historical price at checkout.
corrections.translation: Buka kembali tautan di tab lain. Jika halaman produknya sama tetapi pilihan kembali ke default, tautan itu hanya mengidentifikasi produk. Tetap sertakan nama varian dalam permintaan. Tangkapan layar dapat merekam pilihan yang diinginkan, tetapi tidak menjadikan varian yang habis bisa dipesan atau menjamin harga lama saat pembayaran.

corrections.source: Define the unit and the count
corrections.translation: Nyatakan satuan penjualan dan jumlah yang dibutuhkan

corrections.source: Specify what one unit includes, especially for sets, multipacks and items sold in pairs. Suppose a seller offers a shirt only, shorts only and a two-piece set. Asking for quantity two can mean two complete sets, one top and one bottom, or two copies of the default single garment. State the selected seller option and expected physical contents. For example, “one complete two-piece set, one top and one bottom” is unambiguous if the seller actually offers that choice. Ask first if a desired combination is absent from the listing.
corrections.translation: Jelaskan isi satu satuan, khususnya untuk set, kemasan berisi beberapa barang, dan produk yang dijual berpasangan. Jika penjual menawarkan kemeja saja, celana pendek saja, atau set dua potong, “jumlah dua” masih ambigu. Sebutkan pilihan serta benda yang diharapkan, misalnya “satu set lengkap berisi satu atasan dan satu celana pendek”. Jika kombinasi itu tidak tercantum, tanyakan sebelum memesan.

corrections.source: If different colours or sizes are needed, use separate lines in your request. Keep the quantity on each line and add an overall count for your own check. “One navy M and one grey L” lets you compare the confirmation line by line. “Two shirts, navy and grey, M and L” leaves room for the colours and sizes to be paired incorrectly. If the seller has a minimum quantity or different price tiers, ask about the conditions for the exact mix you intend to buy rather than assuming that any combination satisfies the requirement.
corrections.translation: Untuk warna atau ukuran berbeda, buat satu baris per kombinasi dan tulis jumlahnya. Tambahkan total untuk pemeriksaan sendiri. “Satu biru tua ukuran M dan satu abu-abu ukuran L” membuat dua barang mudah dicocokkan dengan pesanan. Bila ada jumlah minimum atau harga bertingkat, pastikan kombinasi yang Anda butuhkan memenuhi aturan tersebut.

corrections.source: State what to do if the exact option is unavailable
corrections.translation: Jelaskan tindakan yang diinginkan jika varian pilihan habis

corrections.source: A good request distinguishes essential specifications from flexible preferences. Decide in advance whether you accept a different shade, neighbouring size or delayed dispatch. If only the exact version is acceptable, say that the assistant should contact you before purchasing any substitute.
